title: Breast cancer cell motility speed measurement using in vitro assays: a systematic scoping review of current knowledge.
snippet: This systematic scoping review evaluates contemporary advancements in the design and clinical application of lab-on-a-chip (LOC) microdevices specialised for measuring breast cancer cell motility parameters.
